sources.name: BusElche / Avanza official route pages for Lines K1, K2 and L
Current AliBus ordered K1, K2 and L stop pages with municipal stop codes and map coordinates
Accepted A/B/C, D/F/H, E/J and G/I scenarios used for exact shared StopNode and StopPlace reuse

transformations.description: Combines each service's current ordered directional lists into one complete vehicle cycle. Repeated direction handoff and cycle-boundary occurrences are removed, and closesLoop=true adds the final edge once.
Uses the municipal stop code as the stable elche-stop and elche-place suffix. Accepted identities from earlier Elche scenarios are copied exactly.
Creates one strict parser-compatible StopPlace for every new directional StopNode. No proximity-only physical merges are made.
Writes established scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and registers the scenario.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain empty for new nodes because that field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position components. Municipal codes and AliBus coordinate links remain build provenance.
Accepted StopNode and StopPlace objects reused from earlier Elche scenarios retain their exact previous bytes and coordinates.
K1, K2 and L are stored as complete explicit vehicle cycles. The first StopNode is not repeated at the end; closesLoop=true adds the closing edge exactly once.
AliBus labels K1 and K2 as circular and L as normal, while the published L outbound and return lists form one continuous Hospital Vinalopó–Carrús–Toscar vehicle cycle.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges, reverse patterns, or cross-pattern graph edges.
Hospital Vinalopó reuses elche-stop-293 and elche-place-293 from the accepted G/I scenario. K1, K2 and L do not create route-specific copies.
